system.description: Snarfari appears from mist as a very large, six-legged, two-headed stallion and a master warhorse. It obeys its caller or an explicitly authorized rider; only one may be called at a time. It can cover a five-day journey in one day, its nostrils produce mist that gives attackers −3 precision, and it regenerates 1 health point per round. The profile gives Strength +6, 90 health points, Protection 6, movement 24 metres per round, and Fear Factor 1d5. The source does not give a numeric size coefficient; the compendium uses size 3 as a display estimate.

details.summary: A six-legged, two-headed divine stallion that travels with the wind.
details.environment: Temporary manifestation produced by a power or ritual.
